Care & Maintenance

Keep Your Silver Shining

Simple habits that keep your jewellery as radiant as the day you got it.

Store Softly

Keep each piece in its soft pouch or box when not worn.

Wear Last

Put jewellery on after perfume, and remove it before bathing.

Gentle Polish

Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after wearing to restore shine.

Store Apart

Keep pieces separate to avoid scratches and tangles.
